title: Intelligence Exchange
source_topic: ICPC / The 2020 Asia Can Tho Regional Contest
statement: Two students leave home at the same moment and walk to their schools across a weighted undirected graph, each taking some shortest route at the same speed and staying at school after arriving. The task is to count the distinct locations, on edges as well as at vertices, where the two could be present simultaneously, or report that the count would exceed a billion.
